title: The Red Cellar

steps.text: The docks bell rings far below the terrace.
Table four is still waiting for their wine.
Put it on my tab, sweetie. I'll pay Friday.
Friday never comes for you, Candy.
Friday always comes. It just brings a friend.
Justin, the apron is still by the back door.
I still can't tell her I left it there.
Remember what I pay you for, cook.
Rent for the cellar. Nobody goes down there.
Why would the cellar need rent, Justin?
The crates are stamped with a red vintage.
Red wine? The guard fines anyone who keeps it.
I want out of this deal before the docks burn.

choice.say: Nothing down there but old barrels, Ruby.

then.text: Then go show me the old barrels.
Good cook. Keep your mouth shut tonight.

choice.say: The crates are Candy's, and I'm sorry, Ruby.

then.text: You kept that from me for three months.
Careful, Ruby. Your tavern's license is on the line.

steps.text: The cellar lock changed three nights ago.
Someone with a key has been down there.
If you report that cellar, your license goes.

choice.say: I'm going to the guard before this gets worse.

then.text: The guard will hear everything from me tonight.
You just cost me my cellar, cook.

choice.say: The cellar stays shut, and nobody hears about it.

then.text: I'm not going to lie to the guard for you.
Smart choice. The tab is paid tonight.

next: If he lied to protect Candy, Ruby takes him down to the cellar herself.
If he told Ruby the truth, the guard hears about the crates by dawn.
If Ruby reported the cellar, the docks list posts Justin's name at dawn.
If Ruby covered for him, Candy keeps paying rent on the cellar.
